children: US metal 3D printing firm's preliminary Q3 revenue rose 50% yr/yr, beating analyst expectations
Adjusted net loss for Q3 widened and missed analyst expectations
Gross margin improved to 26.5% from 3.2% on higher prices, efficiencies and product mix
Velo3D reaffirms 2026 revenue guidance of $65 mln to $75 mln
Company lowers 2026 gross margin outlook, no longer expects >30% in H2 2026
Capital expenditures for 2026 now seen at $10 mln to $20 mln, down from $40 mln to $50 mln
HIGHER SYSTEM SALES - Revenue growth was driven by an increase in the number of 3D printer systems sold, higher average selling prices and a more favorable product mix

MANUFACTURING EFFICIENCIES - Gross margin improvement attributed to higher average selling prices, improved manufacturing efficiencies, and increased production volumes that improved absorption of fixed manufacturing costs

OPERATING EXPENSES UP - Operating expenses rose as co invested in people, technology and operational capabilities to bring the Livermore Production Campus (Forge 1) online and prepare for expanded production
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 5 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the electronic equipment & parts peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Velo3D Inc is $23.00, about 269.2% above its November 9 closing price of $6.23
